svg.title: Blue Diagonal with Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Museum collection keyword form returned exact Blue Diagonal with Curve (1988) and image 5 D 22669.jpg. Four-edged elongated diagonal form with curved upper-left edge. Entire painted front face included; exposed thickness and wallshadow omitted. Physical dimensions unresolved; normalized to observed support proportions.
